[Data utilities] Evaluates a math expression exactly: + - * / % ^ !, parentheses, big integers and fractions (1/3 stays 1/3), plus sqrt, round, floor, min, max, mean, gcd, lcm, comb, perm, ln, log, exp and trig (radians; deg constant). Returns result, fraction, decimal to N places, repeating decimal and whether it is exact. Input: expr, optional decimals 0-100. Limits: 1,000 characters, 10,000-digit values. Offline.

expr.description: Math expression, up to 1,000 characters, e.g. sqrt(16/9) + cbrt(-27) + 8^(1/3) or comb(52, 5): numbers, + - * / % ^ ! ( ), functions like sqrt(), round(x, 2), constants pi, e, deg

trial.description: Optional. true = answer free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day); otherwise you get the payment terms.
